comment:
Distance: 1700m Conditions: Sunny, strong tail wind with following current for most of the races, with the exception of the G2 race and the B2 race. 
Some of the races started well beyond the starting line, i.e., B3, so you should not compare tiems between different races. Comments: Thank you to Phillips Andover for making the trip to Kent. It was a great day of early-season racing. The Kent Boys won the Brown/Perry trophy, and the Andover girls took home the Perry Trophy. Congratulations to all crews on a strong day of competition!
